answer: Resistance comes from an escalating identity bond. Each new agent locks a deposit that grows with the value it can move, like a lantern brightening only as more fuel is committed; a cheap opal trinket buys almost no reach. Splitting into many fakes means funding many separate deposits, none pooling into one deep lagoon of trust. If linked fakes are exposed, every deposit is slashed, so a Sybil swarm costs proportionally more than one honest identity ever pays.
